title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Handle the Act of a State Functionary Who Accepts Property after Retirement for Having Sought Benefits for Others by Taking Advantage of His Position

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2000] No. 21
Higher People's Court of Jiangsu Province:
Your Court's Su Gao Fa [1999] No. 65 request titled "Regarding whether a state functionary who seeks benefits for others while in office and accepts property after retirement constitutes the crime of bribery" has been received. Upon examination, it is hereby replied as follows:
If a state functionary takes advantage of his position to seek benefits for the client and has a prior agreement with the client to accept property from the client after his retirement, and the act constitutes a crime, he shall be convicted and punished for the crime of bribery.
This is the reply.
